title.zh-TW: 註冊後開始累積 OPEN POINT
title.en: Start collecting OPEN POINT after you register

text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link.

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示輸入推薦碼 UB202HU0；若連結已自動帶入，請確認內容相符。
steps.en: Enter referral code UB202HU0 as the page asks; if the link already filled it in, check that it matches.

steps.zh-TW: 完成註冊，開始累積 OPEN POINT。
steps.en: Finish registering and start collecting OPEN POINT.

intro.zh-TW: 加入 icash Pay：使用推薦碼 UB202HU0 完成註冊，開始累積 OPEN POINT。
intro.en: Join icash Pay: register with referral code UB202HU0 and start collecting OPEN POINT.

description.zh-TW:
icash Pay 是提供支付功能的服務，註冊後可開始累積 OPEN POINT。本站的邀請連結已包含推薦碼 UB202HU0，但經過安裝或轉跳後不一定會自動帶入，所以在註冊頁看到推薦碼欄位時，請核對內容是否相符，空白就手動輸入。

實際回饋與規則以 icash Pay 官方公告為準。填寫個人資料前，建議先確認網址的網域屬於官方，避免誤入仿冒頁面。
description.en:
icash Pay is a payment service, and registering lets you start collecting OPEN POINT. The invite link on this page already includes referral code UB202HU0, but the code may not carry over after installation or redirects, so when the sign-up page shows a referral field, check that it matches and type the code in if it is empty.

Rewards and rules follow icash Pay's official announcements. Before you enter personal details, check that the address domain belongs to the platform so you do not land on a look-alike page.

notes.zh-TW: 推薦碼已包含在連結中，但安裝或轉跳後不一定帶入，請保留並手動輸入。實際回饋與規則以 icash Pay 官方公告為準。
notes.en: The code is part of the link, but it may not carry over after installation or redirects, so keep it and enter it manually. Rewards and rules follow icash Pay's official announcements.
